parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the folding chair is a flat, slightly curved surface made of polypropylene plastic, designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing body weight evenly and ensuring comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged to the frame and can fold upward when the chair is collapsed.

parts.name: Backlegs
parts.Basic_description: The back legs of the folding chair are tubular steel supports that provide structural stability and balance.
parts.Functional_description: They support the rear portion of the chair and connect to the seat and base body through pivot joints, allowing folding motion.
parts.Movement_description: They rotate around the hinge points to fold flat against the seat and base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the folding chair includes the front legs and backrest frame, made of tubular steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main structural frame, supporting both the seat and backrest, and allows the chair to fold compactly.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots at the hinge joints to enable folding and unfolding of the chair.
